title: Smooth hypersurfaces beyond the Chevalley-Warning range
source_problem: AIM, Rational subvarieties in positive characteristic, Other problems, Problem 9.5
scope: The literal AIM disjunction has no explicit smoothness condition. The complete proof establishes the stronger smooth numerical alternative for all primes p, n>=2, and d>=n+1. The norm-form and n=1 caveats remain in PROOF.md.
